police.name: Sierra County Sheriff's Office
police.snippet: The Sheriff's Office maintains a substation in Loyalton to serve deputies on duty east of the Yuba Pass.

court.court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Sierra
court.serves_note: Civil filings handled at Plumas/Sierra Regional Courthouse in Portola (opened December 2009); main courthouse in Downieville
court.snippet: The Sierra County Superior Court is the trial court that serves Sierra County in California.
